text:
Mara: FYI I'm seeing a spike in GPU health score variance in eu-west-1, mostly ECC/Xid noise on the p4 fleet. health_score drops from ~0.98 to 0.87 over the last 20m.
Devin: Seen it too, noticed increased `xid` bursts and a few card resets. Any correlation with recent driver rollouts? :thinking_face:
Li: No driver rollout in eu-west this morning. I pulled the grafana panel — errors are concentrated on two racks (rack-12, rack-14).
Mara: Panel link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/GPUs/gpu-health?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west-1 — look at the per-card error rate and the evict_count.
Devin: Quick check: node exporter shows transient network timeouts for those racks around 04:05 UTC, but not enough to trigger node drains. Could be PCI bus flakiness?
Li: I can run `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC --gpu=...` on affected hosts and grab ECC counts. Will post results in a minute.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-432 — eu-west GPU health variance. Assigned to eng-infra oncall.
Raj: Re: health scoring — current weightings put ECC errors at 0.4, Xid at 0.35, drain_count at 0.25. With these bursts, the composite score flips quickly. Suggest we temporary reduce sensitivity on single-Xid spikes to avoid noisy evictions.
Mara: Good call. We keep seeing noisy single-event XIDs causing partial ejections. Proposal: change Xid weighting to 0.25 and introduce a short cooldown window (10m) that ignores isolated single-Xid events per card.
Devin: I like cooldown + require >=3 XIDs within 5m to increment eviction score. That avoids cascade drains on transient blips. Also add a rack-aware check: if multiple cards in same rack hit threshold within 2m, escalate (possible NIC/PSU issue).
Li: Tests on staging: bumped cooldown to 10m and threshold to 3 XIDs -> dramatically fewer false positives in the sim. I'll open a PR with config and a sample grafana overlay showing new score behavior.
Mara: Can we also add an alert refinement: only page SRE on sustained health <0.85 for 15m or if evict_count increases by >2 in 10m? Lower-severity channel for <0.9 to avoid alert fatigue.
Raj: Agree. Add a metric breakdown panel to the health dashboard that shows contribution per-signal (ECC/Xid/temperature/drains) so oncall can quickly triage.
Devin: I'll add a short runbook snippet to the dashboard: quick steps (check rack telemetry, run `nvidia-health --equery`, escalate to hw team).
Li: Posting the staging GIFs and PR link in thread once CI completes.
Mara: Thanks — once Li's PR is up let's canary the config in eu-west canary pool (10% traffic) for 2h and monitor SLO delta. If stable, roll across region.
Devin: I'll coordinate the canary and leave an automated rollback if evict_count rises. :thumbsup:
Mara: +1.
Li: PR: https://git.redwood/infraconfig/gpu-health/pulls/42 (pending CI).
Mara: Closing loop later today after canary. Thanks all.
